title: VR Experience Salesperson, Santas Sleigh Flight VR Experience – Santa Claus Village, Rovaniemi
description:
**Santas Sleigh Flight VR Experience** is looking for **energetic and sales-minded salespersons** to join our team for the winter season 2026–2027.

We are hiring **one full-time and three part-time employees**.

**About the Role**

This is an **active face-to-face sales and customer service position**. A large part of your working day will be spent approaching tourists, catching their attention, introducing the experience and turning their interest into ticket sales.

You will also guide customers through the VR experience and take care of the daily operation of the attraction.

**Your main responsibilities include:**

- Actively approaching tourists and attracting customers

- Presenting and selling the Santas Sleigh Flight VR Experience

- Handling ticket sales and payments

- Welcoming and instructing customers

- Helping customers with VR headsets and operating the experience

- Disinfecting and charging VR headsets after use

- Opening and closing the attraction

- Keeping the attraction, sleigh and customer area clean and tidy


**Who Are We Looking For?**

You should be **outgoing, energetic, proactive and comfortable approaching new people**. We are looking for someone who enjoys sales and customer service and is able to work independently.

**Previous experience is not required.** Your attitude, personality and willingness to actively approach customers and make sales are what matter most.

**Good spoken English is required.** Other languages are considered an advantage.

**Employment Details**

- **Employment period:** Beginning of November 2026 – approximately the end of March 2027

- **Working hours:** Approximately 10–40 hours per week, depending on your availability and preferred working hours

- **Shifts:** Between 9:00 and 20:00, including weekends and public holidays

- **Location:** Santa Claus Village, Rovaniemi

- **Contract:** Fixed-term seasonal employment under the Collective Agreement for the Adventure Services Sector

- **Salary:**12€/hour gross (grade A–B) + applicable supplements according to the collective agreement. Part-time employees: 9% holiday compensation is paid in addition to the hourly wage

- **Sundays and applicable Finnish public holidays:** Double pay in accordance with the collective agreement

- **Training:** Paid training is provided at the beginning of employment


**Accommodation**

**Please note that we do not provide or arrange accommodation.** Please apply only if you already have accommodation arranged for the employment period.

**Other Information**

Santas Sleigh Flight VR Experience is a **non-smoking workplace**.

Interviews will be conducted and hiring decisions may be made **during the application period**, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact:

**jobs@santassleighflight.fi**

title: Sales Engineer
description:

We are looking forSales Engineer to join our sales team (Chemical & Process).

In the Sales Engineer role, you will be responsible for designing and proposing technical solutions tailored to our customers' needs, specifically for our custom-made Plate & Shell Heat Exchangers.

Your responsibilities will include:

We offer you:- Comprehensive training on our products and industry expertise.

- A growing company in an expanding industry with a focus on innovation and development.
- Activities organized by the leisure committee Huvivaht.
- Smartum wellness and exercise benefits.
- Extensive occupational health and insurance service.


We expect you to have:
- A Bachelors or Masters degree in engineering or other suitable major.
- A technical and innovative approach to solve technical challenges.
- Curious, customer focused and hands-on approach to sales, product, and process development.
- English as your daily work language; other language skills will be seen as an advantage.

Marko Rantala, Business Sector Director, Chemical&Process
+358 44 742 7026, marko.rantala@vahterus.com

If you are interested, please leave your application at latest on 23.08.2026

Vahterus - Who we are
Established in 1990, Vahterus is a Finnish family business focused on sustainable heat exchanger solutions. We are a global company with a headquarter and manufacturing facilities in Finland, and subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, Sweden, China, and the US. Our mission is to provide the best heat exchanger solutions for our customers. Vahterus Plate & Shell Heat Exchangers have extensive applications within the chemical and process, energy, and refrigeration industries.

We aim to maintain our position as forerunners in our field through continuous product development, automated production technology, and strong application expertise. title: Data Engineer for the banking sector in Helsinki
description:
About the role

In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain observability solutions to provide end users with critical insights. You will work within a compact team focused on creating robust data flows and intuitive dashboards.

You are offered
- Independent and responsible role
- Support and guidance from your team and other colleagues
- A hybrid work model with up to 2 remote days per week
- Epassi lunch deduction

Work tasks

Together with your team, you will be responsible for the end-to-end development of monitoring views, from configuring diverse data sources to scripting automation and troubleshooting technical issues.
- Participate actively in team's own planning sessions, suggest improvements, and bring new ideas
- Co-operate with other technical experts and various other stakeholders
- Participate in implementation work and troubleshoot any technical issues on your own area

We are looking for

We are looking for person who has:
- Graduate degree in Computer Science, Telecommunication, or a related field
- Minimum 3 years of corresponding work experience
- Strong skills and knowledge of observability fundamentals including metrics, logs, and traces
- Skills with data source configuration from various sources such as Prometheus, InfluxDB, or AppDynamics
- Good knowledge of data visualization best practices and dashboard design (panels, rows, variables/templating, transformations)
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and provisioning
- Proficiency in JSON and scripting with Bash or Python
- Advanced analysis and troubleshooting skills
- Fluent English communication skills

It is meritorious if you have
- Hands-on experience with Splunk and/or AppDynamics
- Practical experience using PowerBI for statistical visualization
- Experience working in international projects using agile methodologies

For at least the first 6 months, you will work on an assignment for our client in the banking industry. A credit check will be conducted for the selected individual.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Hanken Business Lab Internship: Social Media and Marketing Intern
description:
Hanken Business Lab now accepts applications for a SOCIAL MEDIA AND MARKETING INTERN

from 14 September 2026 to 31 May 2027

Hanken Business Lab is a startup incubator that provides growth-oriented support services to its resident startups and entrepreneurs through mentoring, events, wide international networks, community-building activities, and access to resources in both Helsinki and Vaasa.

Were looking for a creative and driven Social Media and Marketing Intern to join our dynamic, startup-focused team. In this role, youll play a hands-on part in elevating our brand visibility, especially across platforms like LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and our website. Youll work closely with our Head of Marketing and Communications to help craft engaging content that speaks to aspiring entrepreneurs, startup founders, mentors, and investors. This internship is ideal for someone who is passionate about entrepreneurship, loves storytelling through video and long-form content, and wants to gain experience across the marketing and branding spectrum in a fast-paced, purpose-driven environment.

We offer a dynamic and international work environment where youll collaborate with entrepreneurs, industry experts, cross-border partners, and fellow students daily. Youll gain hands-on experience in startup support operations, content creation, and event production. This internship is based on-site at our co-working spaces in Helsinki.

Interns at Hanken Business Lab are considered full team members. You'll participate in team meetings, join internal planning sessions, and contribute to shaping our activities, future initiatives, and your own role. The working language at Hanken Business Lab is English.

We are looking for a well-organised, reliable, and diligent 2nd-5th year BSc or MSc student. Students from Hanken will be given priority in the recruitment process.

Key responsibilities:

- Plan, create, and edit short-form video content (e.g. LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok) that tells others about our events, community, and programs and promotes them to our target audiences;
- Plan and write long-form content (e.g. our website) that shares stories from our community to our target audiences;
- Support day-to-day social media activities, from scheduling posts to community engagement;
- Assist with content planning, campaign brainstorming, and organising assets;
- Help market and document our events through visuals, stories, and recaps;
- Collaborate with the Community Intern regularly, e.g. day-to-day co-working space management, collaboration with Hanken Business Lab's resident startups and entrepreneurs.

Preferred background and skills:

- Comfortable being both in front and behind the camera;
- Previous experience in content creation, storytelling, or social media marketing is considered as a plus;
- Strong communication skills, creativity, attention to detail, and a proactive, team-oriented attitude;
- Ability to successfully manage own tasks without heavy supervision and to handle stress and time pressure well;
- Fluency in both spoken and written English. Swedish and/or Finnish are considered an asset;
- Growth mindset with a positive, proactive attitude toward learning and feedback;
- Genuine interest in and care for startup ecosystem;
- Willingness and motivation to shape your own role and take ownership of your work;
- You approach marketing and communications creatively and have a drive to try and test new things;
- Knowledge and understanding of the most common social media channels and motivation to follow changes, latest developments, and trends.

Students interested in getting ECTS for their internship are welcome to contact their department to ensure that this internship meets the set criteria and can be included in the degree.

The position is 20 hours/week with flexible office hours to be jointly decided upon. The salary is 1270 €/month. The trial period is two months.

Enquiries may be directed to Head of Marketing and Communications Emilia Jansén, e-mail emilia.jansen@hanken.fi, mobile +358 50 472 9695.

A CV and cover letter (as a short video of 2-3 minutes max instead of a written document) must be submitted via Hankens recruitment database (link below) by August 24, 2026, 23:59. Please note that applications without a video attachment will not be reviewed. Please ensure that the link to your LinkedIn profile is included in your CV. Other relevant documents (e.g. certificates, recommendations, portfolio) may be submitted with the application. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview; all interviews will take place on August 27–28 and August 31.

Youll gain hands-on experience in international community management, startup support operations, and event production. This internship is based on-site at our co-working spaces in Helsinki.

Interns at Hanken Business Lab are considered full team members. You'll participate in team meetings, join internal planning sessions, and contribute to shaping our activities, future initiatives, and your own role. The working language at Hanken Business Lab is English.

We are looking for a well-organised, reliable, and diligent 2nd-5th year BSc or MSc student. Students from Hanken will be given priority in the recruitment process. The tasks include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Taking ownership over small-scale community events and assisting with planning, logistics, and execution of larger Hanken Business Lab events (e.g. Slush community events in November);
- Supporting the coordination of day-to-day collaboration with Hanken Business Lab's resident startups and entrepreneurs under the guidance of the Head of Incubation and Community, e.g. carrying out regular check-ins with members, handling member requests, onboarding new member startups;
- Helping to maintain a professional and welcoming work environment in the Helsinki co-working space, ensuring its tidiness and functionality. This includes managing co-working space reservation requests from members, students, and other stakeholders;
- Collaborating with the Marketing Intern regularly (social media content production, long-form content for the website, and general promotional activities).

Youll be a great fit and thrive here if you have:

- Excellent interpersonal, intercultural, and communication skills;
- Genuine interest in and care for community building and startup ecosystem;
- Willingness and motivation to shape your own role and take ownership of your work;
- Proactive, teamwork-oriented attitude and drive to try and test new things;
- Ability to successfully manage own tasks without heavy supervision and to handle stress and time pressure;
- Fluency in both spoken and written English. Swedish and/or Finnish are considered an asset;
- Growth mindset with a positive, proactive attitude toward learning and feedback.
- Proficiency in everyday office software and collaboration tools (e.g. Microsoft, Notion) and social media (e.g. LinkedIn, Instagram) as well as familiarity with and curiosity about AI tools.

Students interested in getting ECTS for their internship are welcome to contact their department to ensure that this internship meets the set criteria and can be included in the degree.

The position is 20 hours/week with flexible office hours to be jointly decided upon. The salary is 1270 €/month. The trial period is two months.

Enquiries may be directed to Head of Incubation and Community Sergei Marostenmäki-Lavrov at e-mail sergei.marostenmaki-lavrov@hanken.fi and mobile +358 50 462 34 35.

A CV and cover letter (as a short video of 2-3 minutes max instead of a written document) must be submitted via Hankens recruitment database (link below) by August 24, 2026, 23:59. Please note that applications without a video attachment will not be reviewed. Please ensure that the link to your LinkedIn profile is included in your CV. Other relevant documents (e.g. certificates, recommendations, portfolio) may be submitted with the application. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview; all interviews will take place on August 27–28 and August 31.

title: Information Security Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Information Security Specialist for our clients public sector tender. Customer industry is in Environmental Services.

Description:
The Information Security Specialist is responsible for developing, maintaining, and monitoring the organizations information security. The specialist ensures that information systems, networks, and services are protected against threats and that information security practices are up to date. 

Tasks may include:
· Preparation and maintenance of information security policies and guidelines
· Threat and vulnerability analyses and risk management
· Management and reporting of information security incidents
· Information security monitoring and audits (e.g., SIEM, SOC)
· User training and increasing information security awareness

Required Skills:
· Experience in information security management and development
· Understanding of information security standards and requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, NIS2) · Experience with information security tools and solutions (e.g., SIEM, EDR)
· Fluent Finnish and English language skills
· Certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, Microsoft Security, CompTIA Security+)
· Experience in cloud environment security
· Knowledge of information security audits and testing

Required experience and competence (within the last 60 months) Minimum requirement:

1. Experience in designing and implementing information security solutions:
The expert has experience from at least three (3) information security solution design and implementation projects that have included both cloud-based and traditional infrastructure environments. Each assignment has had a scope of at least 30 person-days.

2. Microsoft Sentinel competence:
The expert has experience in implementing Microsoft Sentinel, configuring rules and alerts, automation, threat detection, and response in at least two (2) customer assignments.

3. Security of cloud and hybrid environments:
The expert has experience in designing and implementing security for modern Microsoft Azure environments, including Conditional Access, identity management, and data protection, in at least two (2) customer assignments.

4. Security of traditional infrastructure:
The expert has experience in managing the security of on-premises environments (e.g., firewalls, antivirus, AD security, segmentation) in at least two (2) customer assignments.

5. Threat modeling and risk management:
The expert has experience in threat modeling, risk assessment, and planning control measures in at least two (2) customer assignments.

6. Certification:
 The expert has a valid information security-related certificate, such as Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert, SC-200, CISM or CISSP, Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate, Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), EC-Council Certified Chief Information Security Officer (C|CISO), CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+), CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner (CASP+), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Security Essentials Certification (GSEC), Cisco Certified CyberOps Associate, Cisco Certified Network Professional Security (CCNP Security), Certified Ethical Hacker (C|EH), Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP).

7. Information security monitoring and response:
The expert has experience with SOC operating models, alert handling, and implementing incident response processes in at least one (1) customer assignment.

8. Use of automation tools:
The expert has experience with automation tools (e.g., KQL, Logic Apps, PowerShell) supporting information security processes in at least one (1) customer assignment.

9. Information security reporting and documentation:
The expert has experience preparing information security reports, supporting audits, and producing documentation in at least one (1) customer assignment.

10. Knowledge of agile methods:
The expert has experience applying agile methods (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) in information security projects in at least one (1) customer assignment.

title: Outdoor Activity Worker, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Outdoor Activity Workers for Lapland Safaris Saariselkä and Hetta for the Christmas season 2026.**

A workday of an Outdoor Activity Worker consists of various tasks including overseeing outdoor activities in a Christmas themed activity area surrounded by Lapland's beautiful nature. You will be working with international groups of guests, consisting of families with children. Your job is to make sure that all guests, children, and grown-ups are having a day full of joy and fun. The work is mostly independent, but at the same time you are a part of a big team which works in the same area.

Outdoor Activity Workers work during the busiest Christmas season, which means that working days are hectic and sometimes can be long. The length of the days varies according to the group and the program. The work includes preparation of the activity area and different kinds of maintenance work, as well as cleaning the area after the end of the day. The important task of providing clothing for our guests can also be your responsibility, as well as clothing maintenance.

Communication with guests is conducted mainly in English. Your English language skills do not have to be excellent, but you need to be able to give instructions to our guests in English and at least briefly answer their questions or direct the questions to another colleague. Other language skills, especially Spanish is very useful in Saariselkä. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement**

**In Saariselkä** you will introduce tobogganing, mini-skidoo, kick-sledding or tandem skiing to our guests. You can also be working at the reindeer info, pancake-hut or at the warmup cabin. You might also work as a road crosser, when you make sure that the guests are crossing the road safely, either by snowmobile or by walking. In addition, your work tasks may include clothing and equipment maintenance.

**In Hetta** your workplace can be the toboggan slide or bobsleigh hill, you might be teaching the guests to drive the snowmobile, or you might be serving ginger breads in the snow castle and telling stories about the castle itself. You might also be part of the very important team that organizes the visits to Santa Claus himself. In Hetta, providing clothing to the guests and clothing maintenance plays a big role in the Outdoor Activity workers daily routines and work tasks.

**What we expect from you:**

- Energetic and outgoing character

- Flexibility and ability to handle pressure

- Good group management skills

- Christmas spirit and willingness to work with families, especially children


**What we offer you:**

- Great team and beautiful working surroundings

- Versatile and variable working days

- Easy way to experience arctic nature

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will begin in mid-November or at the end of November and will last approximately until the Christmas holidays in Hetta, and until the end of December 2026 in Saariselkä. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 10,10 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

For further information, please contact info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

title: Yövastaanottovirkailija / Night Receptionist
description:
YÖVASTAANOTTOVIRKAILIJAN PAIKKA AVOINNA NORTHERN LIGHTS VILLAGE SAARISELÄLLÄ!

Etsimme oma-aloitteista ja ystävällistä yövastaanottovirkailijaa liittymään tiimiimme. Tämä rooli sopii asiakaspalveluhenkiselle henkilölle, joka haluaa työskennellä ainutlaatuisessa ympäristössä ja olla mukana luomassa unohtumattomia elämyksiä vieraillemme Northern Lights Villagessa.

TYÖN KESTO, PALKKA JA EDUT:

* Työ alkaa lokakuussa/marraskuussa Työ päättyy maaliskuussa

* Työtunnit 90 h/3vko (yötyö), KK palkka (2291 – 2469)

* Muut edut työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti

* Tarvittaessa järjestämme majoituksen jaetussa huoneessa hintaan 300 €/kk

Jos kiinnostuit, laitathan hakemusta tulemaan ja jutellaan lisää!


NIGHT RECEPTIONIST ROLE NOW OPEN AT NORTHERN LIGHTS VILLAGE SAARISELKÄ!


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a proactive and friendly Night Receptionist to become part of our dynamic team. This role is ideal for individuals who excel at customer service and wish to work in a unique environment, contributing to the unforgettable experiences of our guests at the Northern Lights Village.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Welcoming guests and providing exceptional customer service

* Handling check-ins and check-outs efficiently

* Answering guests' queries and providing information about local attractions and activities

* Managing bookings and reservations

* Ensuring the reception area is tidy and well-organized

* Preparing reports and other administrative tasks

* Keeping common areas of reception and restaurant tidy

* Auditing accounting reports

REQUIREMENTS

* 1 or more years of experience in a hotel receptionist role

* Fluent written and spoken English

* Finnish alcohol passport

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Ability to work independently and as part of a team

* Good organizational and multitasking abilities

* Knowledge of property management systems

* High level of professionalism and a friendly demeanour

* Valid category B driving licence (Mandatory)


DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS

* First Aid Certificate

* Knowledge of local area

* Additional language skills

WHAT WE OFFER

* Competitive salary

* Opportunities for professional development and training

* A positive and supportive working environment

* Discounts across our properties and facilities

Pay, Duration and Benefits

* Start: October/NovemberEnd: March

* Working time: 90h/3week period (night work arrangement)

* Monthly salary based on experience and skills: €2,291 – €2,469/month + supplements in accordance with the collective agreement

* Other benefits according to the collective labor agreement

* If necessary, the resort provides accommodation in a shared room for €300/month

HOW TO APPLY

Before applying, please ensure you have the right to work in Finland.

Please note that due to the high volume of applications, we may not reply to applications that do not fulfill the stated requirements. Should your application meet the initial selection criteria, you will receive a reply in early August at the latest.

Ready to be a key player in providing unforgettable experiences at Northern Lights Village? Send us your application and a brief cover letter detailing why you're the perfect fit for our team. Were excited to hear from you!

title: Engine Automation Engineer
description:
We are looking for an Engine Automation Engineer with the main responsibility of engineering solutions for customer engines. This permanent position is part of the R&D and Engineering organization, and the position is located in Vaasa, Finland.

Modern diesel- and gas engines have an embedded engine automation system which forms an essential part of the engine and ensures optimal performance and functionality of the engine. The automation system is specifically configured for each delivery engine to meet the needs for each individual customer application.

We are offering technically interesting and challenging work with good opportunities to contribute to the development of the operations.


Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

* Act as engine automation expert for defined engine types
* Create and test engine automation software configurations for customer delivery projects and maintain related databases and documentation
* Support engine production and engine factory testing in advanced troubleshooting of engine automation systems
* Take part in the execution of customer projects through correspondence and participation in meetings with internal stakeholders and sub-suppliers
* Coordinate and supervise design and deliveries from sub-suppliers
* Support and assist with the commissioning at the customer sites
* Provide technical support for our sales- and supply management organizations regarding engine automation
* Participate in development projects and cooperate with other expert teams in the areas of engine performance, engine design, software development and technical service



To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* Excellent communication and cooperation skills
* Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as part of a team
* Logical thinking and systematic way of working
* Ability to take initiatives and act independently with accuracy in work
* Fluency in verbal and written English as well as Finnish or Swedish
* Motivation to learn and grow professionally
* Good knowledge of basic office tools and willingness to learn other engineering tools
* Technical education, MSc or BSc in electrical/automation engineering, or similar
* Experience of working with internal combustion engines and related automation systems



We offer:

* A working environment with highly skilled and friendly colleagues
* Interesting work with a mix of: Independent behind-the-desk office work
* Hands-on practical work with testing in rigs as well as troubleshooting on real production engines in manufacturing and engine test runs
* Interaction with customers in cooperation with colleagues in e.g. project- and site management

* Appropriate tools and working spaces
* A variety of training activities, learning solutions, self-study materials and on-the-job training for personal competence development


Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.


Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you before the application deadline 23rd of August 2026 by submitting your application through our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

For further questions, please reach out to Johnny Remsu, General Manager / Automation & Control / Customer Delivery through +358 40 5522574 or johnny.remsu@wartsila.com with any questions related to this position (only for questions from direct job applicants, applications through email will not be recorded or responded to).

title: Levyseppähitsaaja / Welder-Platter, Kiuruvesi
description:
Levyseppähitsaaja – vakituinen työ Kiuruvedellä (job description in English below)

Etsimme asiakkaallemme ammattitaitoista levyseppähitsaajaa vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Kiuruvedelle.

Asiakasyrityksemme valmistaa korkealaatuisia osia ja komponentteja kaivoskoneisiin. Työ tarjoaa mahdollisuuden pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen vakaassa ja kehittyvässä konepajaympäristössä.


Työtehtävät

Työssä käsitellään pääasiassa mustaa terästä ja valmistetaan raskaita koneenosia. Työ sisältää:

 * levysepän töitä
 * MIG/MAG-hitsausta
 * paksujen levyjen käsittelyä
 * 50–2000 kg painavien kappaleiden valmistusta ja hitsausta
 * piirustusten mukaista työskentelyä

Työ tehdään tällä hetkellä yhdessä vuorossa, mutta työntekijältä edellytetään valmiutta siirtyä tarvittaessa kaksivuorotyöhön.


Odotamme sinulta

 * alan koulutusta ja/tai aikaisempaa kokemusta levyseppähitsaajan tehtävistä
 * kokemusta MIG/MAG-hitsauksesta
 * levysepän taitoja ja kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti
 * voimassa olevat hitsausluokat katsotaan eduksi
 * hyvää työasennetta sekä halua sitoutua pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen


Kielitaito

Työkieli voi olla:

 * suomi
 * englanti
 * poikkeustapauksissa myös venäjä
 Sujuva englannin tai suomen kielen osaaminen katsotaan kuitenkin eduksi päivittäisen kommunikoinnin varmistamiseksi työnjohdon kanssa.


Tarjoamme

 * vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn
 * kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisen mukaan (palkka alkaen 14,87)
 * työehtosopimuksen mukaiset työehdot
 * mahdollisuuden työskennellä vakaassa ja kehittyvässä konepajayrityksessä
 * mukavan työyhteisön ja pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden
 * tarvittaessa apua majoituksen järjestämisessä


Työpaikan sijainti

Kiuruvesi, Pohjois-Savo

Kiuruvesi on viihtyisä ja aktiivinen maaseutukaupunki Pohjois-Savossa, joka tarjoaa erinomaiset mahdollisuudet asumiseen ja vapaa-aikaan.

Lisätietoja alueesta: https://kiuruvesi.fi/in-english/


Kiinnostuitko?

Täytä hakulomake oheisesta linkistä. Voit halutessasi liittää lomakkeeseen vapaamuotoisen hakemuksen ja ansioluettelon. Hakuun liittyvät kysymykset sähköpostitse kuopio@vps.fi. Ethän lähetä hakemustasi sähköpostiimme.
Mikäli olet jo täyttänyt VPS:n sähköisen hakulomakkeen, käy liittämässä se tunnuksillasi tähän paikkaan.

VPS Henkilöstöpalvelu kuuluu VPS Yhtiöihin ja on vuonna 1987 perustettu suomalainen perheyritys. Olemme henkilöstövuokraukseen ja rekrytointeihin erikoistunut toimija, joka palvelee asiakkaitaan koko Suomessa sekä kansainvälisesti. VPS on HELA Henkilöstöpalveluyritysten Liiton jäsen.
Toimintamme perustuu eettisyyteen, laatuun ja hyvään asiakaspalveluun. Tunnuslauseemme on "Valitsemme parhaat sinulle." 
Lisätietoja yrityksestämme: www.vps.fi

________________________________________________________________________________

Plate Welder / Fabricator – Permanent Position in Kiuruvesi, Finland

We are looking for a skilled Plate Welder / Fabricator for our client in Kiuruvesi, Finland.

Our client is a well-established manufacturing company producing high-quality components and parts for the mining industry. This is a permanent, full-time opportunity offering long-term employment in a modern workshop environment.


Main Responsibilities

Your daily tasks will include:

 * fabrication and plate work
 * MIG/MAG welding
 * working with thick steel plates and heavy components
 * manufacturing and welding parts weighing between 50 kg and 2,000 kg
 * reading and following technical drawings

The work is currently performed in a single-shift system; however, applicants must be willing to work in a two-shift system if required in the future.


Requirements

 * vocational education in metalwork/welding and/or relevant work experience
 * practical experience with MIG/MAG welding
 * strong fabrication and plate-working skills
 * ability to work independently
 * valid welding certificates are considered a strong advantage


Language Requirements

The working language may be:

 * Finnish
 * English
 * in some cases, Russian

However, basic communication skills in English or Finnish are preferred to ensure effective communication with supervisors and management.


What We Offer

 * permanent full-time employment
 * work under the Finnish Technology Industry Collective Agreement (TES)
 * competitive salary based on experience and skills (salary starting from 14,87)
 * stable long-term employment in a growing manufacturing company
 * supportive and professional working environment

title: Sosiaaliohjaaja Koho-hankkeeseen
description:
Etsimme sosiaaliohjaajaa Pelastusarmeijan Tampereen osaston Koho-koulutukseen.

Koho-koulutuksen käyneet ovat kuvanneet kokemustaan mm. näin: Olin ennen elämässäni pelkääjän paikalla. Nyt olen siirtynyt kuskin paikalle. Koulutuksen aikana löysin ensin syyn nousta ylös sängystä aamuisin. Sitten löysin itsestäni syyn nousta ylös aamuisin.

Koho on matalan kynnyksen ryhmä, joka kokoontuu viikoittain kuuntelemaan videoluennon, syömään lounasta ja jakamaan ajatuksia sosiaaliohjaajan johdolla. Jokaisella kokoontumiskerralla pidetään myös hartaushetki. Luentojen aiheita ovat esimerkiksi arjenhallinta, talous- ja velka-asiat, itsetunto, ihmissuhteet ja tunnetaidot. Koulutuksen tavoitteena on auttaa ihmisiä löytämään itsestään voimavaroja oman elämän hallintaan. Koho pitää pinnalla. Yksin on vaikea nousta elämän aallonpohjista.

Kohon sosiaaliohjaaja työskentelee osana pientä moniammatillista tiimiä. Työyhteisöön kuuluu ammattilaisten lisäksi suuri joukko vapaaehtoisia sekä tuettua työtä tekeviä kuntoutujia. Hankkeen loppuvaiheessa pääset kouluttamaan Koho-mallia muille osastoille eri puolilla Suomea.

Vastuullasi on Koho-koulutuksen järjestäminen, ryhmän ohjaus sekä koulutukseen osallistuvien yksilöllinen palveluohjaus ja taloudellisten tukipäätösten tekeminen. Merkittävä osa työtäsi on koulutuksen kehittäminen, materiaalin suunnittelu ja tuottaminen sekä hankkeen tulosten seuranta ja raportointi rahoittajalle.

Koulutushanke on nyt siinä vaiheessa, että luentojen videomateriaali on valmistunut ja verkkoalusta osallistujien ja vetäjien käyttöön on rakennettu. Sinulta toivomme erityisesti osaamista ja näkyä haastavien ryhmien ohjaukseen ja luennon jälkeisen vertaistukihetken materiaalin laatimiseen. Verkkomateriaalin viimeistely on myös yksi tehtävistäsi. Etsimme siis hyvää ryhmänohjaajaa ja kohtaamistyöntekijää, joka viihtyy myös verkkosivun rakennuspuuhissa valmiilla alustalla ja joka huolehtii vastuullisesti hankehallinnosta. Kaikilla työn osa-alueilla sinun ei tarvitse olla valmiiksi ekspertti. Voit oppia tehdessäsi, kunhan olet avoin uudelle ja valmis itsenäiseen tiedonhakuun ja työskentelyyn.

**Hakijalta edellytämme**

- Sosionomin koulutusta tai muuta soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa ja tehtävää tukevaa työkokemusta

- Kokemuksen tai koulutuksen kautta hankittua koulutusosaamista, pedagoginen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi

- Valmiutta vastata hankkeen hallinnosta ja raportoinnista

- Valmiutta toimia verkkoalustalla ja kehittää verkossa tapahtuvaa työtä

- Kokemusta ryhmän ohjauksesta ja erilaisista ohjauksen menetelmistä


Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä työtä kansainvälisessä järjestössä. Saat hyvän perehdytyksen sekä koko tiimin laajan tuen. Mukavien työkaverien ja kannustavan työilmapiirin lisäksi tarjoamme työterveysedun sekä E-passin, jolla saa monenlaisia etuja mm. liikuntaan ja kulttuuriin. Annamme aikaa kohtaamisille ja panostamme työntekijöidemme osaamiseen ja työhyvinvointiin, hyvään vuorovaikutukseen ja johtamiseen.

Tampereen osaston lämminhenkinen yhteisö ja kodikas, sopivan kokoinen työ tarjoavat aidon mahdollisuuden auttaa apua tarvitsevia. Koho-hanke on hyvässä vaiheessa, mutta vielä on paljon tehtävää. Oletko sinä se, jonka osaaminen ja työnäky vievät työtämme eteenpäin?

Hakumenettely

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja cv Teamtailorin kautta 24.8.2026 mennessä. Haastatteluja järjestämme joustavasti hakemusten saavuttua ja palkkaamme henkilön heti, kun löydämme sopivan. Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa työssä mahdollisimman pian. Haku sulkeutuu jo ennen määräpäivää, jos sopiva henkilö löytyy ennen sitä.

Lisätietoja antaa Pelastusarmeijan Tampereen osaston johtaja Kaisu Leino puh. 045 7734 8435, sähköposti kaisu.leino@pelastusarmeija.fi

Työsuhde

Työsuhde on määräaikainen. Noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Työaika

Kokoaikatyö, työaika on 38 h 20 min viikossa, pääsääntöisesti päivätyötä arkisin, mutta työhön voi sisältyä yksittäisiä ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Työtä tehdään sen luonteen vuoksi pääsääntöisesti työpaikalla. Yksittäisistä etätyöpäivistä on mahdollisuus sopia.

Työn jatkuvuus

Määräaikainen. Työ alkaa heti, kun voit aloittaa ja päättyy 30.6.2028.

SOSTES G24D (2 811,09 €/kk 0v, 2 895,42 €/kk 5v)

title: Seasonal Restaurant Worker
description:
Join the Team at Pancake House Levi – Winter Season 2026–2027

Pancake House Levi, located in the heart of Levi, is looking for 6–7 new team members for the upcoming winter season. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, love customer service and can keep smiling even during the busiest hours, we would love to hear from you.

The job includes a variety of restaurant duties: baking and decorating our pancakes as well as serving customers in the dining area. Previous restaurant experience is an advantage, but what matters most is a positive attitude and willingness to learn. We provide comprehensive training, and every employee will learn both kitchen and front-of-house duties.

The work is physically demanding. Front-of-house staff use stairs frequently throughout the day, while pancake baking requires good arm strength and the ability to prepare several pancakes at the same time.

We are looking for reliable people who are committed to their agreed work shifts. You enjoy working as part of a team, take initiative and remain calm under pressure during the busy tourist season.

Since we welcome both Finnish and international guests, applicants should have at least a basic working knowledge of Finnish and be able to communicate in English. You do not need to speak fluent Finnish, but you should be comfortable using it in everyday customer service situations.

A valid Finnish Hygiene Passport is required for this position. If you do not already have one, it can usually be obtained in Finland before starting work. An Alcohol Serving Passport is considered an advantage.

Employment begins gradually from October 2026 and continues until approximately May Day 2027. The exact starting date will be agreed individually with each employee. Depending on business needs, there may also be an opportunity to continue during the following season after Midsummer 2027.

Unfortunately, we cannot provide accommodation, but we are happy to assist you in finding housing.

You are welcome to send either a written application or a short video application—we especially enjoy getting to know applicants through video. Please tell us about a real situation where you successfully stayed calm and provided excellent customer service while working under pressure.

As employers, we are fair, straightforward and approachable. We invest in thorough training and offer a supportive, professional and encouraging work environment where every employee is an important part of the team.

Salary is based on your experience, responsibilities and the Finnish collective agreement for the hospitality industry (Mara TES). Working hours will be agreed individually. Our restaurant is open daily from **12:00 to 20:00**.

**Send us your application and become part of the team creating Levi's favourite pancake experience!**

title: CRM Lifecycle Manager (H/F)
description:
L'équipe CRM de Qobuz est rattachée au département Marketing et managée par la VP Customer Marketing. Elle couvre l'ensemble du cycle de vie client, acquisition, onboarding, rétention, win-back, sur des canaux variés : email, push, in-app, content card, et pages web. L'équipe est organisée par domaine de responsabilité avec un lead par sujet. Ce poste couvre trois axes à fort impact : Product Marketing, Personnalisation, Prévention du churn & Réactivation, avec l'autonomie pour tester, itérer, et voir ses décisions se traduire directement en résultats.

Objectifs :
-Prévenir le churn en détectant et traitant les comportements à risque en amont
-Réactiver les abonnés perdus avec des campagnes personnalisées et différenciées
-Maintenir un niveau d'engagement élevé chez les abonnés actifs
-Augmenter la valeur perçue du produit via une communication ciblée autour des fonctionnalités
-Développer les revenus issus de la base existante (downloads, gift cards)
-Enrichir la connaissance client pour alimenter la personnalisation et la stratégie produit

Indicateurs de performance :
-Rétention : taux de churn mensuel et stabilité de la base abonnés dans le temps
-Réactivation : volume d'abonnés réactivés et évolution mois sur mois
-Engagement : taux d'ouverture, de clic et de conversion par canal et par segment ; profondeur d'usage mesurée via les utilisateurs actifs mensuels
-Adoption produit : taux de reach et d'engagement des communications liées aux nouvelles fonctionnalités ; taux d'adoption des fonctionnalités mises en avant
-Revenus : croissance des ventes de téléchargements et de cartes cadeaux ; performance des campagnes Qobuz Coins
-Satisfaction client : NPS et signaux qualitatifs issus des enquêtes et des comportements post-campagne
-Croissance de la base : évolution nette du volume d'abonnés, de téléchargeurs et de membres Qobuz Club

Missions principales
Prévention de churn
-Identifier les segments à risque via l'analyse comportementale et mettre en place des scénarios de prévention adaptés (baisse d'usage, signaux d'intention de --résiliation, fin d'engagement)
-Gérer le flux de rétention avant résiliation : implémentation des alertes rappels avant expiration de l'abonnement, suivi de performance, itérations
-Piloter les campagnes de prévention sur l'ensemble des canaux (email, push, in-app, carte de contenu, bannières)
-Mesurer l'efficacité des dispositifs et itérer en continu sur les différents leviers : timing, canal, message, offre

Réactivation des désabonnés
-Concevoir des parcours de réactivation différenciés selon le profil et le motif de départ, avec des variantes par type d'approche (offre commerciale, contenu, émotionnel)
-Piloter les campagnes de réactivation sur l'ensemble des canaux disponibles
-Mesurer la performance des campagnes de réactivation, analyser les variantes gagnantes et documenter les apprentissages pour alimenter les plans d'action semestriels

Personnalisation
-Concevoir et déployer des communications automatisées personnalisées au niveau utilisateur : recommandations basées sur les favoris, l'historique d'écoute, le comportement d'usage
-Travailler avec l'équipe Data pour intégrer des signaux comportementaux dans les scénarios CRM (segmentation dynamique, scoring, propension au churn)
-Exploiter les capacités avancées de Braze et autres outils IA à disposition pour industrialiser la personnalisation

title: Infirmier / Infirmière de bloc opératoire Diplômé(e) d'Etat (IBOD (H/F)
description:
En hôpital de jour en chimiothérapie, votre rôle devient essentiel. Chaque patient franchit une étape importante de son parcours de soins : accueil, administration des traitements, surveillance des effets indésirables, accompagnement personnalisé. votre vigilance et votre expertise garantissent une prise en charge sécurisée et humaine.

Organisé(e) et à l'écoute, vous assurez un suivi rigoureux tout en créant un climat de confiance dans des moments souvent sensibles. Vous évoluez au sein d'une équipe, où coordination, technicité et bienveillance sont au coeur de chaque prise en charge.

A ce titre, vos missions seront les suivantes :

1. Surveillance et continuité des soins
- Assurer la surveillance clinique des patients pendant et après l'administration des chimiothérapies : constantes, état général, tolérance au traitement.
- Détecter et gérer les effets indésirables immédiats (réactions allergiques, extravasation, nausées, malaise.).
- Garantir la continuité des soins dans le respect des protocoles thérapeutiques.

2. Soins techniques et actes infirmiers
- Préparer, administrer et surveiller les chimiothérapies selon les protocoles en vigueur.
- Gérer et surveiller les dispositifs d'accès veineux (chambres implantables, PICC line, cathéters.).
- Réaliser les soins associés : pansements, rinçages, pose et retrait de perfusions.

3. Prise en charge de la douleur et du confort
- Évaluer et prendre en charge les effets secondaires des traitements (douleur, fatigue, troubles digestifs.).
- Assurer des soins de confort et adapter la prise en charge en fonction de l'état du patient.
- Accompagner le patient dans un moment clé de son parcours, avec écoute et bienveillance.

4. Communication et transmissions
- Assurer des transmissions fiables et structurées avec l'équipe pluridisciplinaire.
- Collaborer étroitement avec les médecins, pharmaciens et autres professionnels de santé.
- Maintenir une relation de confiance avec le patient et son entourage.

5. Organisation et autonomie
- Gestion de la programmation des rendez-vous de chimio des patients en collaboration avec les spécialistes
- Planifier et organiser les prises en charge dans un contexte de flux programmé.
- Prioriser les soins en fonction des protocoles et de l'état clinique des patients.
- Veiller au respect des temps de prise en charge et à la fluidité du parcours patient.

6. Qualité et sécurité des soins
- Appliquer rigoureusement les protocoles spécifiques à la chimiothérapie (sécurisation des préparations et administrations).
- Assurer la traçabilité des soins et la surveillance des effets indésirables.
- Respecter les règles d'hygiène, de sécurité et d'identitovigilance.
- Participer à la démarche qualité et à l'amélioration continue des pratiques.

7. Information et éducation thérapeutique
- Informer les patients sur le déroulement des traitements et leurs effets secondaires.
- Participer à l'éducation du patient pour favoriser l'autosurveillance et le retour à domicile.
- Répondre aux questions et accompagner le patient tout au long de sa prise en charge.

description:
POSTE :

Au sein de la direction des opérations, vos missions principales seront :

Réaliser la phase de préparation des travaux :

- Récupérer l'ensemble des documents de chantier
- Se présenter à l'accueil et au responsable du site
- Vérifier le matériel de locations
- Signaler les difficultés / problèmes à la réalisation du chantier
- Echanger avec les clients et répondre aux questions

Réaliser la phase des travaux :

- Mettre à jour DOMMS
- Effectuer les montages selon les schémas élec et effectuer une vérification des réglages des équipements (passer les câbles, poser les sondes et capteurs, raccorder les câbles)
- Contrôler tous les équipements montés
- Valider avec le rapport Domms Associé aux tests
- Retranscrire les modifications électriques, les modifications des échelles et seuil, capteurs/calibrage sur les PID et/ou le schéma électrique pour le suivi et mise à jour des documents

Réaliser la phase de SAT :

- Mettre hors Énergie (pression / électricité) les différents équipements à contrôler
- Ouvrir les vannes afin de vérifier la corrélation de celle-ci avec les PIDs.
- Mettre sous tension l'installation tout en respectant les consigne de sécurité
- Valider le fonctionnement de l'ensemble des éléments électriques de l'installation
Faire le reporting sous DOMMS qui sera ensuite utilisé par l'ingénieur lors de la MES et le SAV

Mettre en service l'installation :

- Préparation mécanique de l'installation sous les directives du metteur en service
- Faire une mise en Gaz de l'installation avec le metteur en service
- Vérification de l'étanchéité total des installations
- Terminer le RAF
- Nettoyage du chantier pour réception client


- CDI Forfait 218 jours/an (RTT), non cadre,

- Salaire selon expérience + Indemnités de déplacement (Barème URSSAF) + avance de 1500€ pour vos frais d'hébergement et de repas + prime de déplacements en France et à l'étranger

- Basé à Valence TGV (Châteauneuf sur Isère)

- Notre politique de recrutement est engagée en faveur de l'intégration des travailleurs en situation de handicap



Vous êtes en déplacement et autonomie toute la semaine, sur la zone OUEST de la France et à l'international. Pour cela, vous aurez à votre disposition un véhicule de service type « atelier » avec tout l'outillage nécessaire ainsi que les outils informatiques nécessaire.

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

Cet emploi est accessible aux titulaires d'un diplôme dans le milieu recherché (Bac +2 en électrotechnique, maintenance industrielle, ou équivalent) justifiant d'une expérience réussie dans le milieu d'au moins 5 ans.

Vous êtes autonome, responsable et réactif.ve. Vous avez des compétences confirmées et polyvalence en électricité, électrotechnique, mécanique, robinetterie, instrumentation et automatisme. Des connaissances du biogaz et / ou Oil&Gas (équipements) et des habilitations électriques à jour sont un plus.

Ce poste s'adresse à un.e électrotechnicien.ne curieux.se du monde, maitrisant l'anglais et motivé.e par des missions à l'international lui permettant de découvrir de nouvelles cultures. La maitrise d'une seconde langue (allemand ou italien) sera appréciée.

Vous êtes doté.e de grande capacité relationnelle et d'esprit d'équipe, autant dans le contact avec les entreprises intervenantes sur site qu'avec les collaborateurs et les clients.

Prodeval vous formera les premiers mois à toutes les spécificités de ses métiers, puis régulièrement pour accompagner votre progression professionnelle. Avec la croissance et l'augmentation du nombre d'installations vous pourrez être amené à évoluer au sein de l'entreprise et ses filiales.

Au-delà de votre expérience professionnelle, nous recherchons des personnes motivées, qui aient le sens de l'engagement et du service.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans ce descriptif ? Rejoignez nos équipes !

A pourvoir au plus tôt

title: E-bike Mechanic (m,w,d): French/ English in Paris (E-Bike-Servicetechniker/in)
description:
Start: asap

We are recruiting for a skilled E-Bike Mechanic to join a growing urban mobility team in Paris. You will maintain, diagnose, and repair a fleet of electric bicycles and light electric vehicles, ensuring safe, reliable service for customers. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on technician who enjoys troubleshooting electrical and mechanical systems in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Your Role

- Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and servicing on e-bikes and associated components (motors, batteries, controllers, brakes, drivetrains, suspension).
- Diagnose and repair electrical faults, mechanical issues, and software or connectivity problems using diagnostic tools and technical documentation.
- Assemble and prepare new e-bikes for deployment, including final quality checks and test rides.
- Replace and fit parts (tyres, tubes, brake pads, cables, batteries) and manage stock of common spare parts and consumables.
- Log work completed and fault findings accurately in the maintenance system, including recommendations for recurring issues.
- Collaborate with operations and customer support to prioritise repairs and respond to urgent service requests.
- Advise colleagues and customers on basic e-bike care, safe operation, and battery handling/storage best practices.
- Maintain a clean, safe workshop environment and follow health & safety procedures at all times.

Your Qualifications

- Proven experience as a bicycle mechanic, ideally with specific experience repairing e-bikes or light electric vehicles.
- Good understanding of electric drivetrain components, battery systems, wiring, and basic electronics; able to read wiring diagrams and use multimeters.
- Competence with standard mechanical tools and workshop equipment, and experience with wheel truing, brake adjustment, and gear indexing.
- Fluent in French; good English is an advantage. Communication should be clear and customer-focused.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Valid right to work in France and willingness to work occasional early starts or weekends as required by operations.
- Relevant vocational qualifications (e.g., cycle mechanic certificate, electrical or mechanical apprenticeship) are desirable but practical experience will be considered.

The Offer

- Permanent full-time contract based in Paris with competitive salary depending on experience.
- Paid training on company-specific e-bike systems and safety procedures.
- Comprehensive benefits package including health coverage contributions and transport allowances.
- Opportunity to work with a sustainable mobility provider and contribute to greener urban transport.
- Supportive, multicultural team environment and clear progression routes within operations and technical roles.
- Modern workshop facilities in Paris, with supplied tools and PPE.

title: Développeur / Expert Keycloak & Java (IAM & MFA) (H/F)

Missions Principales
- Développement & Personnalisation Keycloak : Développement de SPI (Service Provider Interfaces), d'authentificateurs personnalisés, d'évènements et d'extensions en Java / Jakarta EE.
- Authentification & MFA : Configuration, personnalisation et intégration de flux d'authentification forte (MFA, WebAuthn, TOTP, SMS, OTP) et gestion des politiques de sécurité.
- Intégration IAM / CIAM : Configuration des Realms, des clients (OpenID Connect / OAuth2, SAML v2) et fédération d'identités (LDAP, Active Directory, Identity Providers externes).
- Personnalisation UI/UX : Adaptation des thèmes de connexion et du parcours utilisateur (Freemarker, HTML/CSS, JavaScript).

MCO :
- Maintien en condition opérationnelle
- Montées de version Keycloak
- Écriture de tests et intégration dans les pipelines CI/CD (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm).

Compétences techniques obligatoires :
Java 11+ / Jakarta EE : Développement d'extensions / SPI pour Keycloak.
Keycloak (Core) : Maîtrise des concepts d'Authentication Flows, Execution Steps, SPI (Authenticator, EventListenerProvider, UserStorageProvider).
Sécurité & MFA : Implémentation du MFA (TOTP, WebAuthn, OTP personnalisés).

Les plus appréciés : Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Operator, Quarkus.

description:

Vous serez amené à voyager régulièrement dans nos différentes destinations en France et à l'étranger, afin d'assurer un support aux équipes et la mise en place d'une gestion opérationnelle optimale.

Tout au long de votre expérience, vous serez immergé dans un environnement stimulant et innovant. Vous rejoignez un group

description:

Spécialisée dans les solutions technologiques de pointe pour le retail moderne, cette entité construit les moteurs de décision basés sur l'IA qui optimisent en temps réel les opérations en magasin sur des dizaines de millions de séries temporelles (forecasting probabiliste de la demande, planification de production, pricing dynamique Ils sont à la recherche d'un(e) AI Engineer pour posséder des features IA de bout en bout et assumer la responsabilité directe de leur impact business : moins de gaspillage, moins de ruptures et plus de marge visibles sur le terrain dès le lendemain.

title: Cavalier (sport)  (H/F)
description:
ocation: China,Shanghai
Position Type: Full-Time
Contract
Schedule: 6 days / week
Vacation: 15 days paid annual leave
Remuneration: Highly competitive salary package (commensurate with experience) + benefits

About the Role
An established, modern equestrian facility in China is seeking a skilled, ambitious Professional Rider & Trainer to join their team.
This role offers an exceptional opportunity for a European-trained or experienced international rider to lead horse development, coach dedicated club riders, and compete at regional and national shows.

Key Responsibilities
* Horse Training & Development: Schooling, producing, and maintaining the competition fitness of sport horses (young horses through to established show jumpers/dressage horses).
* Instruction & Coaching: Delivering high-quality riding lessons and clinics to club members, youth riders, and private owners.
* Competition: Preparing and competing client and stable horses at official shows and national events.
* Daily Riding Management: Collaborating with stable staff and grooms to ensure top-tier care, soundness, and training schedules for assigned horses.

Requirements
* Proven competition track record (Show Jumping or Dressage) with experience producing young horses.
* Strong coaching background with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and safely to student riders.
* Professional attitude, adaptability to working in an international environment, and strong work ethic.
* Relevant riding/coaching certifications (e.g., FN, BHS, KNHS, BPJEPS, or national equivalent) preferred.

What We Offer
* Attractive Financial Package: Highly competitive, well-paid salary tailored to candidate background and competition record.
* Paid Leave: 15 days of paid annual leave per year.
* Work Schedule: 6 working days per week (1 fixed rest day).
* Additional Benefits: Full visa support, accommodation assistance, and travel/flight allowances provided.

How to Apply
Interested candidates should submit their application including:
1. Updated CV / Resume highlighting riding and coaching history.
2. Recent Riding & Competition Videos (flatwork, jumping, and competition rounds).
3. Contact details for Professional References

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Lieu : Shanghai, Chine /
Type de poste : Contrat à temps plein /
Horaires : 6 jours par semaine /
Congés : 15 jours de congés payés par an /
Rémunération : Package salarial très compétitif (selon expérience) + avantages.

À propos du poste :
Un centre équestre moderne et bien établi en Chine recherche un cavalier professionnel et entraîneur compétent et ambitieux pour rejoindre son équipe.
Ce poste offre une opportunité exceptionnelle à un cavalier formé en Europe ou expérimenté à l'international de diriger la formation des chevaux, d'entraîner des cavaliers de club motivés et de participer à des compétitions régionales et nationales.

Principales responsabilités
* Entraînement et formation des chevaux : Travail, valorisation et maintien de la condition physique de chevaux de sport (des jeunes chevaux aux chevaux confirmés en saut d'obstacles ou en dressage).
* Enseignement et coaching : Dispenser des cours d'équitation et des stages de qualité aux membres du club, aux jeunes cavaliers et aux propriétaires privés.
* Compétition : Préparer et présenter en compétition les chevaux des clients et de l'écurie lors de concours officiels et d'événements nationaux.
* Gestion quotidienne du travail à cheval : Collaborer avec le personnel d'écurie et les grooms pour garantir des soins de premier ordre, le suivi de la santé et le respect des programmes d'entraînement des chevaux confiés.

Profil recherché
* Palmarès avéré en compétition (Saut d'obstacles ou Dressage) avec une expérience dans la valorisation de jeunes chevaux.

title: Ingénieur Support Produit Série Aéronautique (H/F)
description:
Description du poste :

Lieu : Rungis, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.

Nos engagements, vos avantages***Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée***Un package de rémunération attractif***Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes***Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l'équilibre des collaborateurs***Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Nous fournissons et soutenons des systèmes pour la gestion et la protection de l'espace aérien. Nous travaillons avec passion dans un cadre architectural moderne, et s'efforce de repousser les limites de la technologie dans nos secteurs clés. Au sud de Paris, notre site est facilement accessible en transport en commun.

Within Thales, you will join teams delivering and supporting advanced air traffic management systems for European customers. Based on a client site in Budapest (Hungary), you will work in an international environment, contributing to the deployment and operational support of critical airspace management solutions.


As a Site Support Engineer, you act as the key interface between the customer and Thales engineering teams, ensuring successful deployment, validation and operational support of air traffic control systems.

You:***Support system deployment, upgrades and integration activities on-site
* Perform validation & verification tests and contribute to system qualification
* Analyze anomalies and coordinate resolution with factory teams
* Interface with the customer to gather needs and provide operational support
* Contribute to system improvements, data configuration and new requirements
* Ensure reporting and communication with stakeholders and project teams

Your profile

Would you like to work on critical air traffic control systems in an international environment?

Is your priority to ensure system reliability and customer satisfaction?
Do you have the ambition to develop your expertise in complex software systems?
Are you eager to discover operational environments at the heart of air traffic management?

You hold an engineering degree or Master's degree (Computer Science or equivalent) and have experience in:
- Air Traffic Control systems or similar complex environments,
- Software systems engineering or development (minimum 5 years Linux environments and scripting (Python, Perl Software architecture and/or network systems

Communication skills, autonomy, rigor, customer focus, adaptability and ability to manage complex situations are strengths recognized in you?

Then this job is for you!

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

description:

Bienvenue chez La Tête Dans Les Nuages !

Depuis plus de 25 ans, La Tête Dans Les Nuages fait vivre à ses visiteurs des expériences de loisirs uniques et immersives.
Arcades nouvelle génération, attractions interactives, réalité virtuelle, anniversaires, événements d'entreprise, moments en famille ou entre amis : nos centres sont de véritables lieux de vie et de divertissement pour tous les publics.

Rattaché(e) au Directeur de Site, vous êtes un acteur clé de l'exploitation quotidienne du centre.

- Participer au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.

- Garantir la bonne application des procédures et des standards de qualité.
- Fédérer les équipes autour de la satisfaction client et de l'esprit de service.
- Assurer le bon déroulement de l'activité durant votre présence.
- Garantir une expérience client exceptionnelle
- Accueillir et accompagner les visiteurs.
- Conseiller les clients sur les différentes offres du centre.
- Accompagner l'organisation des anniversaires, événements privés et séminaires.
- Veiller à la satisfaction des clients tout au long de leur visite.
- Gérer les éventuelles réclamations avec professionnalisme et réactivité.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement du site
- Superviser les opérations d'ouverture et de fermeture du centre.
- Veiller au respect des règles d'hygiène, de sécurité et des procédures internes.

- Participer à la gestion des stocks et des approvisionnements.

- Contribuer à créer une ambiance conviviale et dynamique.
- Participer activement à la réussite commerciale du site.

Votre profil
Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +2 minimum ou disposez d'une expérience équivalente.
Vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie en management de proximité, idéalement dans l'un des secteurs suivants :
Loisirs, Restauration, Commerce / Retail, Hôtellerie, Evénementiel, Distribution.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
Votre excellent relationnel, votre sens du service client, votre leadership naturel, votre dynamisme et votre esprit d'équipe, votre capacité à gérer les priorités et à prendre des initiatives, votre goût pour le terrain et l'opérationnel.

Vous appréciez les environnements dynamiques où aucune journée ne ressemble à une autre.

Conditions du poste

Travail selon planning variable.
Présence requise les week-ends, jours fériés et certaines soirées selon l'activité du site.
Deux jours de repos consécutifs en semaine.
Horaires aménagés dans le respect de la réglementation du travail.
Les avantages
Tickets restaurant après 2 mois d'ancienneté.
Mutuelle d'entreprise.
Prise en charge des transports en commun à hauteur de 50 %.
Intégration au sein d'un groupe leader du loisir indoor.
Participation à l'ouverture d'un nouveau site ambitieux.

Sales Manager mit Drive – von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Closing!

Sales Manager / Account Executive (m/w/d) – B2B Software Vertrieb in Bochum

Wir sind die KEVOX GmbH, ein familiengeführtes Software-Unternehmen aus Bochum. Unsere Software KEVOX ist das „digitale Klemmbrett" für Prüfungen, Wartungen und Dokumentationspflichten. Seit 2010 holen wir Unternehmen aus der Papierwelt in die Gegenwart und machen sie damit sicherer.

Deine Mission: Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle, vom ersten Anruf über Discovery Calls und digitale Demos bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Du verkaufst ein Produkt, das echte Probleme löst, und nimmst dir die Zeit, die ein Kunde für eine gute Entscheidung braucht.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Sales Cycle in deiner Hand: Du steuerst den gesamten Vertriebsprozess von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Abschluss. In digitalen Demos zeigst du, wie aus Papierordnern und verlorenen Prüfnachweisen mit unserer Software ein sauberer digitaler Ablauf wird, führst Discovery Calls und betreust den Kunden bis zur Unterschrift.
- Eigene Pipeline: Du entwickelst dein Kundenportfolio aus warmen Leads vom Marketing und über eigene Outbound-Aktivitäten (Telefon, LinkedIn, Events, Netzwerk). Du pflegst dein CRM (Hubspot), steuerst deine Pipeline.
- Kunden langfristig gewinnen: Weil unsere Kunden erklärungsbedürftige Themen lösen wollen, baust du Vertrauen auf und führst sie zur richtigen Lösung. So werden aus Leads zufriedene Kunden, die bleiben.
- Freiraum & Verantwortung: Du arbeitest eigenständig, setzt die Vertriebsstrategie direkt um und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team bestehende Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Rund 5 Tage im Jahr bist du auf Messen und Branchentreffen unterwegs und identifizierst neue Opportunities.

Dein Profil:

Das solltest du mitbringen:

- Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten oder Services
- Erfahrung im gesamten Vertriebsprozess, von der Ansprache über Opportunity-Management bis zum Closing
- Sicherer Umgang mit Vertriebswegen wie Telefon, Social Selling und Events
- Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen (wie z. B. HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive)
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1+) in Wort und Schrift, da du in der DACH-Region mit Kunden kommunizierst

Was dich ausmacht:

- Du hast eine Hunter-Mentalität und baust dir aktiv eigene Opportunities auf
- Du denkst in tragfähigen Kundenbeziehungen und hast ein Händchen auch für längere Verkaufszyklen
- Du arbeitest gern in einem kleinen Team, teilst dein Wissen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen

Vielleicht bringst du sogar das mit?

- Erfahrung im SaaS- / Software-Umfeld
- Du willst den Schritt vom SDR in die volle Verantwortung für eigene Deals machen und bringst dafür schon erste Jahre Vertriebserfahrung mit

Wichtig: Wenn du heute noch nicht alles davon erfüllst, aber weißt, dass das genau der Job ist, den du machen willst – dann melde dich trotzdem!

Deine Benefits:

- Weiterbildung & Karriere: Austausch mit erfahrenen Vertriebskollegen und 1-on-1 Coachings mit Sales-Experten, sowie ein transparenter Sales Track, der dich mit steigender Umsatzverantwortung bis zum Senior Sales Manager (m/w/d) führen kann.
- Attraktive Vergütung: Fixum + ungedeckelte Provision (OTE: 52.800€ - 78.000€+)
- Wachstumsmarkt: SaaS-Lösung mit klarem USP und großem Impact in einer zukunftssicheren und digitalen Branche. Du zeigst Kunden, wie sie Pflichten in Brandschutz, Arbeitssicherheit und Facility Management einfach und prüfsicher dokumentieren.
- Professionelles Sales Setup: HubSpot, Sales Automation, KI-gestützte Prozesse und Coachings bringen dich schnell auf Flughöhe, unterstützt durch warme Leads und eine bestehende Pipeline.
- Onboarding: Strukturiertes Onboarding mit transparenter Einarbeitung und Feedbackterminen mit definierten Zielen und klaren Erwartungen (On-the-Job-Training, Job-Coaching, Buddy- und Mentor-Programm).
- Arbeitsatmosphäre: Wir schätzen Zusammenarbeit und unterstützen einander, um gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein. Schau gerne mal auf Instagram in unsere Team-Kultur rein!
- Attraktiver Standort in Bochum: Büro mit Aussicht über das Ruhrgebiet im Exzenterhaus Bochum, mitten in NRW und mit direkter Anbindung an Nah- und Fernverkehr (U-Bahn unter dem Haus, Bochumer Hauptbahnhof vor der Tür).
- Nachhaltig unterwegs: Wir bezuschussen dein Ticket für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr.
- Flexibilität & Freizeit im Einklang: 38-Stunden-Woche in Vollzeit & 30 Tage Urlaub (inkl. Jokertage), kurzer Arbeitstag und optionales Remote-Arbeiten am Freitag.
- Weitere Benefits: regelmäßige Feelgood-Meetings und Feedback-Gespräche, Mitarbeiterrabatte, flache Hierarchien und Team-Events.

description:
Organisation ist deine Leidenschaft und du willst mit uns echte Mehrwerte im Bereich der Fortbildung schaffen?

Um einen Beitrag zu leisten, Wunden bezahlbar zu heilen, entwickeln und vermarkten wir bei Dr. Ausbüttel GmbH & Co. KG in Dortmund Produkte und Services zur Wundversorgung. Hinter unseren Marken DRACO und Piratoplast stehen über 250 Menschen mit dem Ziel, wirtschaftlichen Erfolg und soziales Engagement zu verbinden. Als stark wachsendes, zukunftsorientiertes Familienunternehmen ist es uns ein Anliegen, Hochleistung für Menschen zu erbringen, die uns brauchen. Das ist Arbeit, die verbindet.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

- Einen Job mit Sinn, bei dem soziales Engagement und wirtschaftliches Wachstum im Einklang stehen.
- Kurze Entscheidungswege, Freiräume und Selbstverantwortung für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
- Eine integrative Kultur der Chancengleichheit in einem wertegetragenen Arbeitsumfeld.
- Deine Gesundheit ist uns wichtig, deshalb erwarten dich unterschiedliche Maßnahmen und Aktionen zur Gesundheitsförderung.
- Unsere Unternehmenskultur lebt von Präsenz, daher bieten wir dir einen Tag Remote Work an.
- Wir nehmen uns Zeit für deine Einarbeitung. So erwartet dich ein strukturiertes Onboarding und eine Begleitung durch Mentoring.
- Netzwerken durch Austauschformate: Dabei lernst du uns und unsere Werte noch besser kennen und kannst mit neuen Kollegen gut ins Gespräch kommen.     

Das sind deine Aufgaben

- Du sorgst für die Organisation und Koordination von Terminen für deine Leitungskraft, das Team und stimmst dich mit internen und externen Ansprechpartnern ab.
- Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und Nachbereitung von Terminen, erstellst Protokolle sowie Präsentationen und bereitest Unterlagen für Meetings vor.
- Bei der Einarbeitung von neuen Kollegen unterstützt du aktiv z.B. durch die Erstellung von Einarbeitungsplänen.
- Auch die Prüfung und Abwicklung von Rechnungseingängen und Abrechnungen liegen bei dir.
- Du arbeitest an abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten und Themen mit.

Das bringst du mit

- Organisations- und Planungskompetenz: Die Fähigkeit, Termine effizient zu planen, zu priorisieren und Terminkonflikte frühzeitig zu erkennen.
- Eine sorgfältige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du gehst deine Aufgaben systematisch und zuverlässig an und legst dabei Wert auf Qualität und Genauigkeit.
- Einen sicheren Umgang mit den MS Office Produkten.
- Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung und mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung z.B. als Assistenz, Projektassistenz.

Persönlichkeit ist uns wichtig

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn du positiv eingestellt bist, in stressigen Zeiten die Ruhe bewahrst und zum Lachen nicht in den Keller gehst.     

Erzähle uns etwas über dich als Person: Wofür begeisterst du dich und was geht überhaupt nicht für dich?     

Um dich zu bewerben, sende uns gerne deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen zu Händen Volker Kutz (Leiter Content-Fortbildung).
